title: Tooling: faster SharedPointCircuit.__init__ and verify_frames with identical receipts
head: ff889ccd768f4e78f338910b143feae60ad555ce
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea` (folded onto merged [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994) verify digests), this PR rewrites two residual hot paths on `scripts/shared_point_circuit.py` with identical receipts:

1. **`SharedPointCircuit.__init__`** — pre-sorts `local.active` / `local.outputs` once, unpacks children directly, binds hot lists/dicts locally, keeps historical node-allocation order (`research/shared-point-init/`).
2. **`support_in` / `verify_frames`** — replaces thrashing process-wide `lru_cache(maxsize=16384)` with a per-instance dense table indexed by `node * h + common`, plus local nesting closures (`research/shared-point-frame-contains/`). Folded here because it edits the same production file. On `h=46` the dense table is large (~hundreds of MB of Python object slots); that is a deliberate space/time trade for the historical full-size checker, not a selected-frontier memory claim.

Every structural field and every verify / `verify_frames` receipt stays identical. The bit-compression certificate does not list `scripts/shared_point_circuit.py` in `source_sha256`. Production `verify` keeps #1994’s hand-rolled digests.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs:

- `SharedPointCircuit(46)` construction only: median **0.649 → 0.438 seconds (1.48×)**
- `SharedPointCircuit(46).verify_frames(code)` only (construction/compile excluded): median **2.888 → 1.729 seconds (1.67×)**

Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-init/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/shared-point-init/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-point-init
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-init/benchmark.py --rounds 5

python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-frame-contains/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/shared-point-frame-contains/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-point-frame-contains
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-point-frame-contains/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SHARED_POINT_INIT verify_cases=5 mutant=rejected certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/shared-point-init outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_SHARED_POINT_INIT_RECEIPTS

PASS_SHARED_POINT_FRAME_CONTAINS cases=5 json_files=4 certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/shared-point-frame-contains outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_SHARED_POINT_FRAME_CONTAINS_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Historical nesting checks use `assert` and are stripped under `-O`; structure / receipt identity remain the gates. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.
